newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian manufacturing input prices rise in June.
newsitem.headline: Australian manufacturing input prices rise in June.

text.p: Australian manufacturing input prices rose 1.2 percent in June from the previous month and were 1.2 percent lower than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
"Higher livestock prices were the main contributors to the increase in the index," the bureau said.
"Price falls for domestic crude oil partly offset the overall increase."
The bureau said prices for cattle, sheep, lambs and pigs increased due to seasonal factors, while domestic crude oil prices fell in line with world prices.
The index stood at 106.4, its highest level since 106.7 in February.
